Supreme Court of India struck down the 99th amendment to the constitution (2014). This amendment created a body named NJAC- National judicial appointment committee. S.C. struck down NJAC as it impinges upon the principles of 'independence of judiciary" as well as "separation of powers". Oﬃ cial Language *Oﬃ cial language is mentioned in part-XVII (Art. 343-351) of the Indian constitution. *According to Art. 343, the oﬃ cial language of the union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script and the digits used for oﬃ cial purpose shall be international form of Indian numerals. *According to Article 344, the president has the power to form a commission related to oﬃ cial language. *First oﬃ cial language commission under the chairmanship of B.G. Kher was constituted in 1955. *According to Art. 344 (4) there is a provision to form a 30 member joint parliament committee on oﬃ cial language. The committee consists of 20 members from Lok Sabha and 10 members from Rajya Sabha. *Any language canbe added in Indian constitution under the 8th Schedule. *Initially only 14 languages were added to the Indian constitution. *'Sindhi' language was added to Indian constitution by 21st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1967. *Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali were added by 71st constitutional Amendment Act 1992 in 8th schedule. *In 2003, Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and santhali were added by 92nd Constitutional Amendment.
